dialogues.speaker: Vanya
dialogues.text: I... I encountered something terrifying... I... I found a flat gold nugget with runes drawn on it...

dialogues.speaker: Vanya
dialogues.text: Then someone... grabbed me by the shoulder... took me to... this person. He took the gold, and handed me some strange drink...

dialogues.speaker: Vanya
dialogues.text: I drank... again... and again... and now I've forgotten... so much. Don't even remember... my way home...
